events.headline: THORChain pauses operations after Ethereum reorg triggers double refund
events.eventClass: swap pause / outage (emergency pause after Ethereum reorg caused a duplicate 10 ETH refund)
events.relevance: THORChain halted swaps across most cross-chain bridges for all users (12 of 13 chains paused per The Defiant status data); no resumption reported and no official THORChain statement found
events.sourceName: Crypto Briefing (also TokenPost, PANews citing Chainalysis, The Defiant)

events.headline: Binance confirms security breach: ~$6.3B impacted, ~$3B frozen, withdrawals paused ~45h
events.relevance: Escalation from rev1 suspected: Binance confirms ~$6.3B impact (~$3B frozen), compromised DevOps laptop plus other breach points, withdrawals paused ~45h; no private-key leak found; BNB down ~8% to ~$693
events.sourceName: Cointelegraph live blog (also Fox Business, NPR, ABC, Hacker News)

events.sourceName: crypto.news (cites Trade.xyz X post; also Coinpedia, Altcoin Buzz, PANews)
